WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
For record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.

1.
CALL TO ORDER.
Chair Ledford called the meeting to order at 7:30 p.m.
2.
ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR HOFBAUER, DIRECTORS LACKEY, BETTENCOURT, AND DISPENZA
PRESENT:
Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Hofbauer, Director Lackey, Director Bettencourt, Director Dispenza.
ABSENT:
None.
3.
WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S).
Motion: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting.
Moved by Director Lackey,
seconded by Director Bettencourt.
Vote: Motion carried (5-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Hofbauer, Director Lackey, Director Bettencourt, Director Dispenza.
4.
CONSENT CALENDAR - PUBLIC COMMENTS:
None
5.
CONSENT CALENDAR:
5.1
Adopt Resolution No. SA 2013-001, a Resolution of the Successor Agency to the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Palmdale ratifying and approving all Successor Agency warrants issued and voided on behalf of the Successor Agency to the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Palmdale since the last Successor Agency warrant register dated October 29, 2012 and payroll register dated October 25, 2012 and approved by the Successor Agency on December 5, 2012. (Staff Reference: Director of Finance St. John)

5.3
Approve the Minutes from the previous meeting held on December 5, 2012 (7:00 pm). (Staff Reference: Agency Secretary Smith)
Motion: Move to approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under the Consent Calendar.
Moved by Director Lackey,
seconded by Director Dispenza.
Vote: Motion carried (5-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Hofbauer, Director Lackey, Director Bettencourt, Director Dispenza.
6.
PUBLIC COMMENTS HEARD JOINTLY WITH CC & PCA:
Vincent Columbia spoke regarding Learning Plaza, traffic tickets being given to parents at drop off.
Councilmembers Lackey and Bettencourt suggested City Manager coordinate a meeting with Anne Ambrose and School District to discuss problems with drop off/pick-up.
Kamal Khatib with handout spoke regarding New Guidance Charter School.
Harold Brand spoke regarding illegal dumping.
7.
ADJOURNMENT:
Chair Ledford adjourned the meeting at 8:10 p.m. to February 6, 2013 at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Suite B, Palmdale, California.
PASSED, APPROVED, and ADOPTED this 6th day of February 2013.
